input.quote: 2.1 Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
input.rationale: A USD 2,000,000 per year, three-year take-or-pay with no reduction or termination rights is our walk-away position and contradicts Section 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges we have made no minimum-volume commitment. We replaced it with our fallback: no standing commitment, any Order Form commitment limited to the current 12-month term, reducible on 30 days' notice, ending on termination, and any shortfall handled by a carry-forward true-up rather than a penalty.

input.quote: On expiry or termination, Customer's right to access terminated subscription Services ends after any agreed transition period.
input.rationale: Section 10 assumes an "agreed transition period" but no clause obliges Vendor to provide exit assistance or to return or export Customer Data in a usable format, and Section 16.5 defers Customer Data to an absent Section 11 — leaving us exposed to loss of access to hosted health data on exit. We inserted a new Section 10.3 requiring up to six months' transition assistance at then-current rates, return/export of Customer Data in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter.
